PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat ? (1 mark)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn? (1 mark)

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
